name: Müsli
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¾ cup (180 g) unsweetened dried coconut
¼ cup (60 g) chopped dried mangoes
⅓ cup (80 g) chopped dried apples
⅓ cup (80 g) chopped dried apricots
¼ cup (60 g) chopped raw cashew nuts

steps: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl, then transfer to an airtight container to store.
Serve with milk, yogurt, honey or berries. The dried müsli will keep for up to a month in airtight container.
